name: Franklin County, PA
findings: Franklin County has 538 nonprofit organizations. 245 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 201 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 8 political organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.
